provenance.benchmarkMethod: Linear-interpolated empirical quantiles from exact times/lh_t/networth_t checkpoints; gold_t is never substituted for net worth
provenance.buildMethod: Group observed first two major purchases; show newest actual purchase log in the largest group. Timings are that match, not a universal target.
provenance.skillMethod: Recorded ability_upgrades_arr from the same representative match, mapped by exact current Valve ability IDs. Array-only levels are an earliest-legal reconstruction, not recorded hero levels; innate abilities are excluded.

caveats: Dota2ProTracker is a browsing reference only; this cached dataset comes from the public OpenDota API.
OpenDota patch IDs identify base patches and cannot verify the current minor-letter patch.
This is a small observational sample with the actual date range shown, not a current-patch meta guarantee.
Missing or unparsed replays, role inference, match duration, and the league population introduce selection bias.
Farm quantiles describe these samples; personal farm targets remain separate and editable.
A purchase in a winning match does not establish the best item for this matchup.
Skill order is observed; levels reconstructed from an upgrade array may differ if the player saved skill points. The current Valve ability catalog does not verify the match minor patch.
